766740101.text: My oh my, the final product has exceeded all my expectations... If anyone actually does stumble in here by mistake, I'm sure they will be truly awe-inspired by this mage's might.

766740104.text: Well, that all depends on the sort of person they are.

766740105.text: Guidance can encourage complacency and entitlement if you're not careful. If someone is eager to rely on their own abilities, like you do, then I'll gladly help them.

766740106.text: But if they're the type of person who pins all their hopes on the mage's power, while doing none of the work themselves... Hehe.

766740107.text: ...W—Would you really turn them into a statue?

766740108.text: No, nothing like that. But I would guide them out of this place to the nearby Curatorium of Secrets. I'm sure Nefer would know how to deal with them much better than I do.

766740109.text: Those who seek to reap without sowing ought to pay the price, don't you think?
